title: Shrogea MH-V e2-1763 Tourist Installation
excerpt: Tranquility’s Stop maintains a tourist installation in orbit of the black hole within a planetary nebula found in Shrogea MH-V e2-1763, adjacent to the Black and Green Tourist Beacon.
